trial_court: Court of learned Additional District Judge (2), Kangra at Dharamshala, District Kangra, HP (HMA No. 27-D/III/2015)
case_name: Smt. Nivedita Fatura vs Sh. Aditya Fatura
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Petitioner's husband filed a divorce petition against her under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act. She is unemployed and has a minor child to take care of, making it difficult for her to defend herself in Dharamshala.

legal_principles.principle: The court may transfer a case to ensure the petitioner's ability to defend herself.
legal_principles.held: Presently, she is residing at Mandi with her parents and is dependent upon them, not only for her upkeep but probably for the upkeep of her minor child also.

legal_principles.principle: The court may consider the convenience of both parties when deciding whether to transfer a case.
legal_principles.held: it is also not in dispute that proceedings which have been initiated by the petitioner against the respondent under the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005, are pending at Mandi and the respondent is defending himself in the said proceedings at Mandi
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

outcome.final_order: The case was transferred from the Court of learned Additional District Judge (2), Kangra at Dharamshala, District Kangra, HP to the Court of learned District Judge, Mandi, District Mandi, HP.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
